I posted the list to your DM. It has 11 sites, each with its source. Where a source gave only a store name or ticket, I said so.

Caveats:
- I read the last 15 messages in #central-team, not its full history, and I did not read #central-random.
- The brain search is keyword-only, and 53 pages haven't been scanned for entity names, so the list may be incomplete.
- Several Salina and Kearney references in the search results belong to Marrow Fieldworks, the parent account, so I left them out.
